```python
def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Locate the solid separator.
    if any(len(set(row)) == 1 for row in grid):
        sep = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1)
        panels = [grid[:sep], grid[sep+1:]]
    else:
        sep = next(j for j in range(w) if len({grid[i][j] for i in range(h)}) == 1)
        panels = [[row[:sep] for row in grid], [row[sep+1:] for row in grid]]
    # Select the panel with fewer nonzero cells (the sparse binary pattern).
    panel = min(panels, key=lambda p: sum(v != 0 for row in p for v in row))
    return [[2 if v != 0 else 0 for v in row] for row in panel]
```

```python
def transform(grid):
    sep = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 9 for v in row))
    top, bottom = grid[:sep], grid[sep + 1:]
    top_bg = max(set(v for row in top for v in row),
                 key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in top))
    bottom_bg = max(set(v for row in bottom for v in row),
                    key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in bottom))
    return [[2 if top[r][c] != top_bg and bottom[r][c] != bottom_bg else 0
             for c in range(len(grid[0]))]
            for r in range(min(len(top), len(bottom)))]
```
